entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse monitor. I'm just... not happy with it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a fault. The heart rate is completely wrong, it jumps around. Honestly, this thing is just garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear it's not performing as expected. In cases of a technical fault, the first step is to connect you with our tech support team. They can usually resolve these kinds of tracking issues in just a few minutes.

Oh, I really don't have time for all that. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and I'm just so disappointed. I just want money back for this. It wasn't cheap, and I really could use the refund right now.
I understand your frustration, and I want to help. Since you're declining technical support, let me just check the return eligibility based on your purchase date. Can I have your order number?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered 44 days ago. Let me just check our policy.
Alright, I've confirmed it. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery, so you are unfortunately outside the window. I can go ahead and process this return for you immediately.
Oh, really? Wow. That's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

Not at all. I'm happy to get this sorted out for you. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just package the item up, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
That's wonderful. You've been very helpful. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
